source_reads: Reuse source bodies already obtained by the Store search, while validating owner/identity and capture confirmations in bounded512-row batches.

Increase value-scan page size to512 without limiting total rows; retain namespace and source ordering.
Exclude the current query within the same visible-corpus enumeration before assembly/ranking, rather than enumerate the whole bank twice.

Compare every reconstructed byte directly with the still-existing case before removing its redundant working directory; no digest/fingerprint.
Restore to a fresh independent directory from explicit base plus archive. Original databases, model inputs/outputs and trace bytes remain recoverable.
The base is a required part of the artifact collection and must remain unchanged; an individual case archive is not standalone.
